html:
The emperor of Japan from 1926 to 1989, known in Japan as the Shōwa Emperor. He reigned through Japan's wars in Asia and the Pacific, its defeat, and its rise to economic power.

Under the Meiji Constitution he was sovereign and supreme commander, though in practice he mostly approved what his ministers and generals decided. In his name Japan seized Manchuria in 1931, invaded China in 1937 and attacked Pearl Harbor in 1941. How much he shaped these choices is still argued.

After the atomic bombings and the Soviet entry into the war, he backed surrender. On 15 August 1945 his recorded voice told the nation by radio that Japan would accept defeat. Most Japanese had never heard him speak.

The American occupation under General MacArthur kept him on the throne and did not put him on trial. In 1946 he denied his own divinity in the Humanity Declaration, and the new constitution made him a symbol of the state. He spent much of his later life on marine biology.
